_comment: Reviewed verdicts for docs/OVERLAP.md. verdict: covered | partially covered | MEND-only. 'method' says how each tool was assessed on 2026-10-14: run = tool executed on bad/ and fixed/; source = rule source code read (tool could not be installed). Re-review when overlap.json shows '(differs)'.

fastapi-app-add-event-handler-removed.note: No FAST rule covers app.add_event_handler/on_event removal (FAST001-003 only). ruff run; bump-pydantic n/a.

fastapi-strict-content-type-json-body.note: Runtime content-type behaviour change; no static rule. ruff run.

fastapi-templateresponse-request-first.note: Argument-order change in TemplateResponse; no rule. ruff run (only E501 incidental).

fastapi-testclient-allow-redirects.note: httpx-based TestClient kwarg rename; no rule. ruff run.

numpy-2-removed-aliases-nan-float.note: ruff NPY201 (stable, not in default rule set) flags np.float_, np.NaN, np.Inf on every pattern line; unsafe autofix produces the fixed code. ruff run.

numpy-array-copy-false-raises.note: NPY201 has no entry for np.array(copy=False) semantics. ruff run + numpy_2_0_deprecation.rs read.

numpy-nep50-uint8-scalar-overflow.note: NEP 50 promotion change is value/dtype dependent; no static rule. ruff run.

numpy-trapz-removed.note: ruff NPY201 (stable) flags np.trapz and np.in1d (also np.product, np.cumproduct, np.row_stack) and autofixes trapz -> trapezoid. Message says 'will be removed in NumPy 2.0' (they were deprecated in 2.0, removed in 2.4) but the fix is right. ruff 0.16.8 run + main@a8632f8 source read.

pandas-cow-chained-assignment-noop.note: No PD rule for chained assignment. ruff run.

pandas-cow-inplace-on-column-noop.note: ruff PD002 flags both inplace=True calls and its unsafe autofix produces df[col] = df[col].fillna(...). Its stated reason is generic ('inconsistent behavior'), not the Copy-on-Write no-op. ruff run.

pandas-dataframe-append-removed.note: No PD rule for DataFrame.append. ruff run.

pandas-offset-alias-m-removed.note: No rule for 'M'/'H' offset aliases. ruff run.

pandas-series-int-key-not-positional.note: Needs type info (Series with non-integer index); no rule. ruff run.

pandas-str-dtype-not-object.note: No rule for dtype == object checks. ruff run.

pydantic-v2-allow-mutation-ignored.note: bump-pydantic BP002 lists allow_mutation in REMOVED_KEYS: it deletes the key and adds a TODO comment instead of emitting frozen=True, so the model silently becomes mutable. bump-pydantic source.

pydantic-v2-allow-population-by-field-na.note: bump-pydantic BP002 renames to populate_by_name in model_config. bump-pydantic source.

pydantic-v2-anystr-strip-whitespace-igno.note: bump-pydantic BP002 renames anystr_strip_whitespace/anystr_lower to str_strip_whitespace/str_to_lower. bump-pydantic source.

pydantic-v2-basesettings-moved.note: bump-pydantic BP004 rewrites the import to pydantic_settings. bump-pydantic source.

pydantic-v2-conlist-min-items-removed.note: bump-pydantic BP008 rewrites conlist(..., min_items, max_items) to Annotated[List[...], Field(min_length, max_length)]. bump-pydantic source + its unit test.

pydantic-v2-custom-root-type-removed.note: bump-pydantic BP006 only matches the assignment form `__root__ = T`, not the usual annotation `__root__: T`, and never rewrites `.__root__` reads. bump-pydantic source (root_model.py ROOT_ASSIGNMENT_MATCHER).

pydantic-v2-field-regex-removed.note: bump-pydantic BP003 renames Field(regex=) to pattern=. flake8-pydantic PYD001 fires on bad and fixed alike (Field(...) positional), so not counted. bump-pydantic source; flake8-pydantic run.

pydantic-v2-json-dumps-kwargs-removed.note: bump-pydantic does not touch .json()/.dict() calls; no ruff rule. bump-pydantic source; ruff run.

pydantic-v2-optional-field-required.note: bump-pydantic BP001 adds `= None` to Optional fields. ruff UP045 fires on bad and fixed alike (not counted). bump-pydantic source; ruff run.

pydantic-v2-orm-mode-ignored.note: bump-pydantic BP002 renames orm_mode to from_attributes. bump-pydantic source.

pydantic-v2-root-validator-skip-on-failu.note: bump-pydantic BP007 cannot refactor a bare @root_validator (not a Call): it only adds a 'TODO[pydantic]: please create the model_validator manually' comment and does not address skip_on_failure or the mode='after' signature. bump-pydantic source.

sqlalchemy-2-connection-autocommit-remov.note: No static linter rule; SQLAlchemy's own path is runtime SQLALCHEMY_WARN_20 warnings in 1.4. ruff run.

sqlalchemy-2-raw-string-sql-needs-text.note: No ruff rule fires on the pattern line. ruff run.

starlette-1-app-route-decorator-removed.note: No ruff rule for Starlette. ruff run.

starlette-1-on-startup-removed.note: No ruff rule for Starlette. ruff run.
